pest-control-resistance.alt: Line graph, invented data for practice. The percent of pests resistant to a pesticide after each two generations of regular spraying: 1, 2, 5, 12, 27, 50, 73, 88 and 95% at generations 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14 and 16. The share rises slowly, then quickly, and levels off near 95%.
